name: 1Password
description: The 1Password CLI account, for servers started with `op run` or that call `op`. 1Password has no machine-wide switch (the CLI uses the account you last signed in to), so pick it per profile; servers get OP_ACCOUNT.

fields.label: Account
fields.list: op account list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR > 1 && NF >= 2 { print $1 "\t" $2 }'

sign-in.label: Sign in
sign-in.description: Runs `op signin` for an account; approve it in the 1Password app.
